title: The Separation Market
learning_focus: Decantation, winnowing, scooping, picking, evaporation, filtering, sieving, magnets; benefits and useful products.
story_premise: A market’s rice, sand, water, metal pieces, and dissolved materials are mixed after a storm.
mission_objective: Complete the three connected areas and apply the mission learning focus: Decantation, winnowing, scooping, picking, evaporation, filtering, sieving, magnets; benefits and useful products.

areas.title: Hand Separation Stall
areas.story: Use picking, scooping, or winnowing for suitable mixtures. Separate particles by size.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Science Guide
opening_dialogue.text: The station in Hand Separation Stall is not working correctly.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Science Guide
opening_dialogue.text: Use picking, scooping, or winnowing for suitable mixtures.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Science Guide
opening_dialogue.text: Observe carefully, investigate Decantation, winnowing, scooping, picking, evaporation, filtering, sieving, magnets, record the evidence, and use it to restore the station.

learning_clues: Science focus: Decantation, winnowing, scooping, picking, evaporation, filtering, sieving, magnets.
Record observations and measurements before forming a conclusion.
